```{r setup}
source("R/_load.R")
```

```{r}
mv_hurr <- load_multiverse("hurricane")
mv_hurr
```

# Overview

```{r}
mv_hurr |>
  get_multiverse_decisions()
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
vis_multiverse_simple(mv_hurr, direction = "right")
```

# Existing Methods

## Regression

```{r}
reg_hurr <- calc_regression(mv_hurr, colname_metric = "mean_deaths")
attr(reg_hurr, "tidy")
```

### Performance

```{r}
reg_hurr |> 
  model_performance()
```


### Model Fit

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 12
# All-in-one model checks
reg_hurr |> 
  check_model()
```

Posterior predictive check comparing simulated data from the model to actual observed data. Uses R's `simulate()` function on the lm.

```{r}
reg_hurr |> 
  check_predictions()
```


```{r}
vis_residuals_vs_fitted(reg_hurr)
```

```{r}
vis_observed_vs_predicted(reg_hurr)
```

```{r}
vis_observed_vs_predicted(reg_hurr, type = "kde")
```


```{r}
#| fig-height: 3
#| fig-width: 7
vis_observed_vs_predicted(reg_hurr, type = "hist", facet = T)
```

### Coefficients

```{r}
vis_regression_coefficients(reg_hurr)
```

## FANOVA

```{r}
fanova_hurr <- calc_fanova(mv_hurr, colname_metric = "mean_deaths")
fanova_hurr
```

```{r}
fanova_hurr |>
  head(10) |> 
  fanova_to_vec() |> 
  vis_importance()
```

Only main effects

```{r}
fanova_hurr |>
  filter(is.na(level_1)) |>
  head(10) |> 
  fanova_to_vec() |> 
  vis_importance()
```


# Our Framework

```{r}
within_hurr <- calc_within_bucket_variation(mv_hurr, colname_metric = "mean_deaths")
within_hurr
```

```{r}
vis_importance(within_hurr)
```

```{r}
between_hurr <- calc_between_bucket_variation(mv_hurr, colname_metric = "mean_deaths")
between_hurr
```

```{r}
# NA leads to problem
vis_importance(between_hurr)
```

## Combine

```{r}
vis_importance_2dim(
  between_hurr,
  fanova_hurr |> fanova_to_vec()
)
```
